title: Repository Baseline and Verification
objective: Understand the current state of the repository, inventory existing assets, classify file types, and establish a baseline for all subsequent work.
acceptance: Repository baseline report generated and committed
Asset migration status document created
Asset classification and migration strategy documented

title: Project Foundation
objective: Create monorepo structure, install dependencies, set up build and test infrastructure.
acceptance: Monorepo structure initialized with frontend and backend directories
Package managers configured (npm/yarn)
Build toolchain configured (Vite for frontend, express for backend)
Development server runs without errors

title: Core Data Models and Persistence Layer
objective: Define and implement core data models for Application, DesignPlan, Roadmap, and AgentRun. Set up persistence layer.
acceptance: TypeScript interfaces defined for all core models
Persistence layer abstractions implemented (File/DB adapter)
Migrations framework in place
Unit tests pass for all models

title: Backend API Foundation
objective: Implement Express.js API with request/response validation middleware, error handling, and CRUD endpoints for core models.
acceptance: Express server starts and handles requests
Validation middleware enforces contract schemas
CRUD endpoints functional for Application, DesignPlan, Roadmap models
Error handling middleware returns proper HTTP status codes

title: Frontend Shell and Professional UI System
objective: Create React SPA with Vite, establish component library, professional design system, and responsive layouts.
acceptance: React application initializes with Vite
Component library established (Button, Form, Modal, Card)
Design tokens and Tailwind configuration complete
Responsive layout works on mobile, tablet, desktop
UI library documented with Storybook

title: Application Intake Workflow
objective: Implement first complete feature: user describes application idea, system accepts and stores it.
acceptance: Application intake form renders and submits successfully
Form validation prevents submission of incomplete data
Application record created in persistence layer
User receives confirmation with application ID
Integration test covers happy path

title: Design Plan Generation Service
objective: Implement service that calls Claude to generate design plan from application description.
acceptance: Design generation endpoint accepts application ID
Claude API called with appropriate prompt
Design plan structured response parsed correctly
Design plan persisted to storage
Cost tracking recorded

title: Design Plan Approval Gate
objective: Implement UI and logic for user to review and approve generated design plan.
acceptance: Design plan review page displays plan details clearly
User can approve, reject, or request changes
Approval state persisted to database
Rejected plans can be regenerated
Audit trail recorded

title: Roadmap Generation Service
objective: Implement service that generates implementation roadmap from approved design plan.
acceptance: Roadmap generation endpoint accepts design plan ID
Claude called to generate roadmap
Roadmap structured with phases, dependencies, and acceptance criteria
Roadmap persisted to storage
Cost tracked

title: Roadmap Approval Gate
objective: Implement UI for reviewing and approving generated roadmap.
acceptance: Roadmap review page displays phases with dependencies
User can approve, reject, or request changes
Approval state persisted
Integration test covers full intake→design→roadmap approval flow

title: Agent Registry and Manager
objective: Implement system to register, manage, and introspect agent definitions from agents/*.yaml.
acceptance: Agent registry loads from agents/ directory
Agent definitions expose I/O contracts
Agent manager UI allows viewing agent capabilities
Agent lookup endpoint functional

title: Prompt Refinement Workspace
objective: Create workspace for reviewing, testing, and iterating on agent prompts.
acceptance: Prompt editor loads from Prompts/ directory
Prompt can be tested against sample inputs
Test results displayed (tokens, latency, quality)
Refined prompts saved to version control

title: A2A Contract Manager
objective: Implement system to manage A2A contracts and validate handoffs between agents.
acceptance: Contract schema loaded and validated
Contract validation middleware enforces I/O contracts
Contract violations surfaced with clear errors
Gap analysis updated based on current schema coverage

title: Thin Vertical Orchestration Spike
objective: Prove end-to-end orchestration: approved roadmap → execute one phase with one agent → record results.
acceptance: Single phase can be executed via orchestration endpoint
Agent called, output captured, artifact created
Run state machine transitions correctly
Cost and audit trail recorded
End-to-end integration test passes

title: Agent Execution Abstraction
objective: Define and implement clean abstraction for agent execution that decouples orchestration from specific agent implementations.
acceptance: AgentExecutor interface defined and documented
ClaudeExecutor implementation functional
Executor can be mocked for testing
Contract validation integrated into executor lifecycle
Unit tests cover executor contract enforcement
